result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and consistent. The main visual problem is horizontal content clipping: the category filter chips and the 'Fastest near you' restaurant cards are cut off at the right edge without any visual affordance (fade/scroll hint) indicating more content is available. A few minor polish issues also exist.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal card row is clipped at the right edge ('Trattoria Piccol...' card and its image are cut off mid-card) with no scroll indicator, fade-out gradient, or peek affordance to signal that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade gradient or partial-card peek plus consistent card spacing so users understand the row scrolls horizontally; ensure the last card has proper trailing padding.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip and no scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade or chevron to indicate additional categories are available via horizontal scroll.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without an ellipsis in a way that looks abrupt against the clipped card.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis and a max-width so long names degrade gracefully.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards are icon-only with no visible label, and the notification bell relies solely on a small red dot to convey unread state.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels (e.g., aria-label 'Add to favorites') and a text/badge count or tooltip for notifications to improve screen-reader and clarity support.
